fearSpendOptions.label: Make a GM move
fearSpendOptions.rules_text: Spend Fear to make a GM move when the fiction calls for stronger pressure.

fearSpendOptions.label: Make an additional GM move
fearSpendOptions.rules_text: Spend Fear to make an additional GM move.

fearSpendOptions.label: Spotlight an additional adversary
fearSpendOptions.rules_text: Spend Fear to spotlight an additional adversary during battle.

fearSpendOptions.label: Use an adversary Fear feature
fearSpendOptions.rules_text: Spend Fear only if the adversary or feature provides that option.

fearSpendOptions.label: Use an environment Fear feature
fearSpendOptions.rules_text: Spend Fear only if the environment or feature provides that option.

fearSpendOptions.label: Add adversary Experience to a roll
fearSpendOptions.rules_text: Spend Fear to add a relevant adversary Experience to a roll.
